initialization.fresh: empty memory; adaptive applicability and train-derived tool statistics
initialization.reference: empty memory; previous exact-question visual-reference method

learning.execution_change: Controller sees only visible question, schema and observations; tools/final answer receive learned HCL guidance. Explicit finalize node; no model weight change.

development.use: parent development only diagnoses failure mechanism; new selection allocated for acceptance

confirmation.ci: paired bootstrap20k seed2026111603 and exact two-sided McNemar; secondary descriptive unadjusted

shared_answer_interface: same shortest answer / digits for count / semicolon for multiple items; no answer vocabulary; different from old experiments
limitations: A bounded source-policy mechanism experiment, not a novel complete continual-learning method.

arm_definitions.GR: reference method final state after two batches; exact question retrieval
arm_definitions.GN: proposed final state, adaptive retrieval and tool history
arm_definitions.GP: same proposed final state, no tool history supplied to controller
arm_definitions.GE: same proposed final state, exact-question retrieval, tool history retained

method.match: same visible-question intent plus exact match OR frozen text similarity above train-only cross-intent 95th percentile; rank 0.7 text cosine + 0.3 image cosine; recognizable object terms must agree for non-exact matches
method.unknown_question: require exact match for unknown intent; otherwise abstain if threshold fails
method.source: only deployed/candidate raw records with training-only image registry; no query self-reference
method.reference_order: prefer distinct corrected answers, then deterministic source-id tie break
method.image_location: reference images first; current target image last; separate explicit labels
method.scope: VQA only; historical other-task interface unchanged
method.calibration: first 24 training examples visible text/images only; no future-batch labels/images in threshold calibration
method.tool_history: per-intent tool-sequence counts, final and first-tool correctness from training only; min2 episodes per sequence; max3 sequences; no historical answers or freeform instructions to controller
method.learning_gate: policy statistics stored inside raw candidate memory, committed and rolled back together
method.feature_cost: separate timed forward-pass receipts; visible-feature cache only, no prediction cache

evidence_method.training_source: parent 48 training cases only; reused from committed parent state
evidence_method.feedback_contracts: reuse prior project vqa_diagnostics_v3 contract idea; compile color/location label vocabulary from training feedback only, not a novel component by itself
evidence_method.contract_application: tool and final answer nodes; matched across contract and evidence arms
evidence_method.independent_tools: for image-answer tools, remove HCL historical guidance and speculative controller instruction, retain current image/question, generic tool task and training-derived contract; crop tool uses current question in a neutral observation request, retaining proposed coordinates
evidence_method.controller: unchanged schema and optional parent training-tool statistics; observes actual results
evidence_method.main_candidate: evidence; fixed before any parent confirmation result inspection
evidence_method.comparison: base vs contract vs evidence; contract is ablation, never fallback winner
evidence_method.gate: evidence vs base on new selection48: net gain>=1, 72 historical old-correct losses<=2, current format>=.95; reject => no confirmation
evidence_method.shifted: fixed one-step cyclic permutation of 100 current target images; original questions/labels and training-reference images unchanged; diagnostic only, never selection
evidence_method.scope: one mechanism candidate from feedback, not rerunning HCL.train or updating model weights

DESIGN_BASIS: Parent completed development24: color1/4, location0/4 for both arms; training trajectory repeated/assertive requests; prior vqa_diagnostics_v3 shows location contract confound. No parent confirmation metrics inspected to choose this design.

routing.incumbent: previous training-derived color/location independent routes, fixed from ROUTING_CANDIDATE before any new fitting
routing.candidate: override incumbent with contract-only path for intent if train support>=4 and netgain>=1 with zero loss; otherwise keep incumbent unchanged
routing.variants: incumbent guided/independent path vs contract-only; output constraints enabled without removing historical/controller tool guidance in contract mode
routing.empty_policy: no supported contract overrides => end without acceptance/confirmation
routing.fit_data: same reused training48 and frozen learned memory; execute both arms anew
routing.confound_previously_recorded: need contract-only control documented in 04:14 and 04:44 notes before routing confirmation results were read
routing.outcome_selection_forbidden: previous routing confirmation not used to choose overrides, thresholds or arms

data_plan.isolation: no current routing confirmation cases reused; neither partition used to fit policy
data_plan.prior_unused_proof: previous action gate rejected, supervisor success, no confirm_* workers; exact source set100 preserved
